name: Dettlaff Mini v0.1
notes: Uses the Trifolium v1.4 connectors and pins, so v1.4 harnesses plug in unchanged.
No pusher driver. Run the pusher on an ESC channel, or set Pusher Driver to FET on GPIO 27 for an external FET board on the pusher header.
Re-pin Betaflight-order and NewBeeDrone Cricket ESC harnesses before use: their reversed power order destroys the DShot inputs.
